summary: @or-sdk/lookup preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The npm package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` file with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers, a large numeric/string constant array, and a `WV8StW` string-array push/shift rotator. The package's declared purpose is a small HTTP SDK (`dist/cjs/index.js` is a normal compiled TypeScript library) — it ships no C/C++ source, no node-gyp, and no publisher-owned native prebuilt that would justify pulling a second language runtime at install time. The alternate-runtime pattern executes a bundled, non-auditable payload under a freshly-downloaded Bun binary as part of `npm install`, evading Node-only static tooling. The `math_init` filename does not correspond to any functionality of a lookup SDK.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
